data.one_liner: 6,000+ free stroke-rounded SVG icons for Flutter with custom stroke width and color inheritance.
data.what_it_does: Provides an extensive library of over 6,000 vector-based SVG icons for Flutter applications. Includes support for automatic theme color inheritance, dark mode, stroke width adjustments, and tree shaking to keep app bundles lean.
use_when: You need a large, cohesive set of modern stroke-rounded icons for your UI.
You require fine-grained control over icon stroke widths and colors.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Material Design or Cupertino icons built into the framework.
You need a completely different icon style not provided by Hugeicons.
strengths: Supports tree shaking so only used icons are included in the final bundle
Allows customization of stroke width and secondary colors
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party icon library rather than native platform sets

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the widely-used Font Awesome icon set instead of Hugeicons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean Lucide icon style for your Flutter application.
